train.note: Genesis Mean reward is episode return. DiffAero total_reward is per-step mean.

eval.note: Protocols differ. DiffAero: 4096 envs, 10000 steps, randomizer off, target vel 5. Genesis short: 256 envs, 2500 steps, same randomizer/vel, deterministic mean then env clamp.

evidence: Trained actor mean is entirely outside [-1,1] (absmax ~69). rsl_rl has no tanh; env clamps. DiffAero PPO is tanh-squashed. Action std grew 0.24 -> 20.8. Task metrics during training still rose (gates 0 -> 19).
